small_repo.note: ensure_ms ~26ms includes index build on the tiny fixture; warm reuse parsed=0

real_repo_warm.note: ensure_ms = index-ensure+manifest; wall includes manifest recompute + graph load + query + projection build + serialize. related hard-capped at 256 (§32).

key_findings: Faithful projection ~3x the legacy machine bytes (added rank/ranges/endpoints/rule/cs), still bounded: seeds<=50, related<=256, ranges<=seeds, routes<=2.
Current-range materialization performs ZERO reparses (BROAD_REPARSING_FOR_RANGE_MATERIALIZATION=false): it reads stored FileAnalysis JSON, bounded by decl-seed count.
Warm ensure latency unchanged (~9-17ms real repo); the gate adds no index work — projection+serialize is the only added cost, proportional to emitted records.
Focused queries (relationship/path) produce tiny faithful packets (<1-2KB); broad lexical queries bound at 50 seeds / 256 relations.
